behaviours.name: Fel Monstrosity (Stamina)
behaviours.observe_source: 500067 Effect[0] aura 137 SPELL_AURA_MOD_TOTAL_STAT_PERCENTAGE, MiscValue 2 (Stamina), BasePoints 19 + 1 = 20 ($s1). The caster's exact Stamina (Player::GetExactStatValue, unrounded) is read before and after a real learn of 500067 (the reading before is the control without it): reference stat 2 = 79 (class file) x 1.20 = 94.8, ratio judged within 0.002 so +19% (93.99) and +21% (95.6) are excluded. Bless 804247 is the harmless self cast in both phases. Reference search 2026-11-23: coa-history spell 500067: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive leaves no event; positive control 801904 Azzinoth's Assault: 21 casts); the bindmysoul snapshot is an older state (it says Stamina 25%; the DBC tooltip says 20% and prevails); expected values come from the tooltip and the DBC only.

behaviours.name: Unbound (melee critical strike rating)
behaviours.quote: Increases your dodge and critical strike rating by $s1% of your Agility
